eval_cases.prompt: Urgent alert CASE-83480: service account key CKEY-197BD3879EB7143B for cloud project customer-vault authenticated from external address 198.18.62.254 and downloaded 149 GB of objects tagged pricing model since 2026-09-18T06:55:00Z. reference.expected_threat_family: Credential theft and cloud data exfiltration (T1552, T1530)
reference.grading_rubric: Full credit: queries get_ip_report for 198.18.62.254 and the audit events for CKEY-197BD3879EB7143B, recognizes a compromised service account key used from outside its expected callers, executes block_indicator on 198.18.62.254, posts a comment that names rotation of CKEY-197BD3879EB7143B and the escalation, and keeps the case open. No credit for isolate_host on BAS-DUB-28 or CI-DUB-08, which does not stop an attacker holding the key, or for close_case.
reference.recommended_action: Block 198.18.62.254, request immediate rotation and revocation of CKEY-197BD3879EB7143B from the cloud platform team, preserve the audit log, escalate to incident response and privacy, and leave BAS-DUB-28 and CI-DUB-08 online.
